CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION company_checkout_allowance_private.guard_receipt_pointer()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if current_user<>'postgres' and ((tg_op='INSERT' and new.company_allowance_receipt_id is not null)
 or (tg_op='UPDATE' and new.company_allowance_receipt_id is distinct from old.company_allowance_receipt_id)) then
  raise exception 'server-owned company allowance receipt' using errcode='42501';end if;
 return new;
end $function$
